extractions.value: Patient had polio at age 2 with residual left leg weakness and atrophy. Centripetal nystagmus is a rare finding, and this is the first reported case in association with anti-GAD65-associated neurological disorder. Parkinsonism was also present, resembling PSP/MSA.
extractions.quote: A 68-year-old woman with a history of hypertension, hypothyroidism, and polio at age 2 (with residual left leg weakness)... As far as we know, this is the first reported case of centripetal nystagmus in association with an anti-GAD65-associated neurological disorder... Parkinsonism, namely, a combination of asymmetrically slowed movement, rigidity, and tremor, is an uncommon manifestation of an autoimmune condition but has been associated with anti-GAD65 antibodies.
